title: Jju language — Grokipedia
text: Jju, also known as Kaje, Kache, or Diryem Jju, is a Benue-Congo language of the Niger-Congo family spoken primarily by the Bajju (or Banyet Jju) people in southern Kaduna State, central Nigeria.
